changeLog.summary: User confirmed that the currently functional HealthHub modules now appear stable after the day’s fixes. Sync, Health Connect, Sleep, Profile Vault, profile data handling, medication explanations and diagnostics are operating without the previously observed blockers.

Restored the private healthhub-private-reference-v1 medication explanation package used by the 'Mire való?' helper. The package remains private/local rather than a public GitHub asset. Import was tested by the user and confirmed working.
Repaired Profile Vault sync by upgrading its Health Connect bridge IndexedDB access to schema v2 and hardening Dropbox /HealthHub and /HealthHub/profiles folder checks. User confirmed sync working.

Fixed the Health + Activity sync failure caused by missing IndexedDB object stores. All active Health Connect consumers were aligned to bridge database schema v2 so imports/activity stores are created consistently.

Hardened Dropbox folder handling in both the Android HealthHub Connect bridge and Device Cloud sync. Existing folders are checked before creation, 409 races are revalidated and detailed HTTP/path diagnostics are logged.

Added persistent Admin Error Log with runtime error, unhandled Promise, console warning/error and sync failure capture. Added refresh, copy, JSON export and clear controls plus subsystem-level sync diagnostics.

Repaired editable profile data restoration. Historical migrated values stored under legacy profileData are flattened into the current profile schema without allowing empty new fields to overwrite useful migrated data; legacy and current representations remain synchronized.
Consolidated Sleep onto the canonical dashboard, removed duplicate competing Sleep handlers and made the page read Health Connect sleepSessions from Dropbox Cloud Vault with local IndexedDB fallback.
Added the shared Timeline hero visual, reduced the hero copy to only Zsolt Timeline / Mónika Timeline, removed legacy dropdown artifacts and implemented direct one-click profile switching.

Leletek now open the original stored PDF inside a dedicated HealthHub viewer instead of relying only on a browser blob-tab/download flow. The viewer includes separate external-open and download actions and also supports stored image documents.

Medication reminders now offer five selectable generated sounds, a 20–100% volume slider, immediate preview using the current selection, and profile-specific sound/volume persistence. Existing reminder settings migrate with an 85% default volume.

Activity data mapping was aligned more closely with Samsung Health through Health Connect: active calories are separated from total calories, exercise sessions carry distance and active calories, 'Ma' uses the local calendar day, and pace is calculated only from distance-bearing walking/running sessions. HealthHub Connect v0.7.0 adds the required active-calorie permission and schema 1.2 export fields.
Activity bottom navigation is now anchored to the viewport bottom instead of the scroll container, preventing the task bar from covering category cards and page content.
Health Connect Pilates sessions are classified into a dedicated Pilates category instead of Egyéb. Activity categories were reorganized into a balanced 4×2 mobile grid.
Activity hero now uses the real current HealthHub profile avatar and canonical profile picker rather than generated placeholder portraits.

Activity was rebuilt from the approved visual baseline with functional period controls, KPI cards, charts, activity categories, recent sessions and manual activity entry. The approved HD hero was integrated as the live visual.
Introduced the Activity summary module and iterated its approved mobile visual, hero fit, pixel alignment, live controls, category handling and manual-entry workflow.

Added profile-specific daily medication reminders with configurable times, medication selection, browser notification request, sound preview, reminder modal, 10-minute snooze and 'Bevettem' acknowledgement.
Added the Sleep dashboard and Sleep Helper, fixed loading/click/page collisions, applied HealthRadar visual theming, and introduced API-free/visual Insights.

Added one-tap Health Connect SYNC NOW, persistent device-owner protection and sync status, scheduled background sync support in Connect v0.6.0, Health Connect-aware measurement deletion, tap fixes and expanded trend views.
Added Dropbox Health Vault with PKCE, automatic push/pull synchronization after Health Connect import, autosave hardening and live app-version visibility in Admin Data Hub.

Hardened profile switching across HealthRadar pages, fixed latest raw Health Connect heart-rate selection with paginated reads, and automated HealthHub Connect APK release publishing/version metadata.

Daily fallback no longer depends on the workflow starting in an exact local hour; delayed scheduled runs repair any stale morning feed. Added an immediate push-trigger repair when fallback logic changes. HealthRadar profile control now opens the canonical profile picker instead of using the wrong navigation/switch path.
Fixed a render race where the legacy v1.49 lifestyle renderer could remove the restored v1.51/v1.52 lifestyle panel moments after it was drawn. Legacy renderer now leaves the restored panel intact.

Lifestyle dashboard now reconstructs activity/sleep/nutrition/body metrics across Health Connect import history, preventing a later minimal import from hiding previously imported steps, distance, calories, exercise, sleep, nutrition, resting HR, VO2max or body-fat data.

Restored and hardened Health Connect lifestyle cards after v1.50. Steps, distance/walk, burned calories, exercise sessions, sleep, nutrition, resting heart rate, VO2max and body fat are rendered as a standalone block after the Today snapshot and re-rendered safely after HealthRadar updates.

Unified HealthRadar-related pages to the same hero image/height/layout language as the main HealthRadar hero. Fixed measurement delta overlap, enlarged metric cards, converted metric categories into visual selector cards, and improved period controls for touch use.

Expanded Health Connect Bridge schema to 1.1 with activity, exercise, distance, total calories, sleep sessions/stages, nutrition macros/energy, body fat, resting heart rate and VO2max. HealthHub receiver accepts both 1.0 and 1.1 and adds lifestyle summary cards.

Added a visual 'Mai állapot' health snapshot with prominent latest BP, pulse, SpO2, weight, glucose and steps, measurement deltas, timestamps and last Health Connect sync indicator. Built on the successful real S24 Ultra Zsolt end-to-end import.

Added HealthHub Connect Android MVP and live Health Connect JSON receiver. Android bridge reads BP, HR, weight, glucose, SpO2 and aggregated daily steps; receiver enforces profile separation and deterministic dedupe. Verified debug APK build; phone E2E test pending.
Home hero daypart logic changed from fixed clock windows to actual Budapest sunrise/sunset. After sunset the dark/night background is applied automatically.
Unified current Budapest weather and daypart logic. Weather refreshes from Open-Meteo and the Home hero switches according to the same actual sunrise/sunset data.
Removed excessive full-image hero dimming for both profiles and all dayparts. Added wide autumn night scenes with moonlit water for Zsolt and illuminated Budapest with Danube reflections for Mónika.
Added a distinctive HealthHub heart-and-cross favicon and launcher identity, with a dedicated manifest scoped to HealthHub and icon metadata preserved during bundled HTML loading.

Introduced lightweight profile-scoped Léna Health Context and later filtered invalid zero clinical placeholders. Context includes measurements, sleep, activity, medications, appointments, document index and signals without bulk-reading PDF blobs.
Added private Léna Context cloud mirrors to Dropbox and Google Drive. Google OAuth uses drive.file scope and session-only access tokens; no private medical payload is committed to public GitHub.
Added resumable, sequential full original-document mirror to private Google Drive, separated into Monika and Zsolt folders. Uploads one source blob at a time and later runs as delta sync.
Added Léna Research Router: natural-language question → profile, timeframe, clinical domains, required data sources and ranked document candidates.

Added Document Retrieval Engine: targeted Drive originals are opened sequentially and PDF.js extracts searchable source text; OCR-needed files are flagged. Initial acceptance: 5/5 documents, 0 failures, 22,072 extracted characters.

Added clinical/temporal relevance refinement, evidence extraction and source-aware timeline building. Historical questions now prioritize documents near the strongest event anchor instead of merely matching category.

Added Answer Composer with concise human-readable response sections: documented facts, likely interpretation, and what cannot be established. Source chips link claims back to original Drive documents.
Added Smart Ask Léna orchestration with text or supported Hungarian speech input. One action runs Health Context refresh, routing, retrieval, evidence, answer composition and private ChatGPT handoff.

Real mobile end-to-end test passed via Ask Léna voice input and Research + ChatGPT. The system returned the correct complete historical answer and successfully produced both standard PDF and mobile PDF outputs.

Symptom Journal / Ad-hoc Health Event Log promoted to the next HealthHub development priority ahead of Nutrition Connect, Cognitive tracking and Digital Wellbeing. Scope includes symptom episodes, PRN/OTC medication intake, outcome tracking and Léna Research integration.

Implemented the Continuous AI Improvement Engine foundation in the Admin Console: operational System Health + RAG, lightweight local-first telemetry, measurable improvement suggestions, Wishlist/User Story Repository and the Level 3 approval/backup/remediation/validation guardrail.

Stopped the AI Improvement Center self-triggered DOM render loop that caused rapidly increasing long tasks and visible slowdown. Added baseline-aware error scoring, safe FIX remediation with telemetry archive/reset, and an event-driven remediation progress indicator.

FIX completion now updates the top RAG badge and metrics immediately. Added low-overhead event-driven live-build detection so future HealthHub deployments refresh automatically when the app regains focus/visibility or Admin opens, avoiding manual browser/PWA restart.

Wishlist MEHET is now an execution action rather than a silent status change. WISH-002 runs System Health Check + RAG and reports Running → Done; already implemented foundation items can validate immediately; future items enter a visible AI implementation queue.

Wishlist actions now explicitly distinguish validation from code implementation. Completed/implemented items show RUN VALIDATION; proposed code work shows MEHET → CODE IMPLEMENTATION; approved queued work shows CODE IMPLEMENTATION · QUEUED.

Implemented Level 3 Code Execution foundation: Admin execution jobs, secure Google Drive/ChatGPT handoff, GitHub execution status manifest, automatic pre-change backup branch, static quality gate and safe automatic rollback on failed main validation. No GitHub/API secret is stored client-side.

Implemented WISH-007 Central Manual Sync in Admin Data Hub. One command synchronizes the active profile across Profile Vault, Daily Cloud, Health + Activity Cloud, Devices Cloud and Léna Context with step-by-step status, failure isolation and persistent last-run state.

Reduced Admin/Level 3 UI overhead by throttling remote execution-status refresh to 15 seconds, skipping unchanged status payloads, and preventing unnecessary full Level 3 rerenders. Manual refresh remains immediate.

Removed legacy high-overhead DOM watchers: Error Log no longer observes the full document or polls every 1.8s; Document Recovery no longer watches the full document; profile picker observer is scoped to its overlay; dynamic typography full-body observer is disabled; Cloud Vault full-body observer is removed; Device Cloud observer is scoped and no longer auto-syncs on every window focus.

Removed Dropbox/Device/Léna cloud work from profile/focus critical paths; made Profile Repair startup/exception-only instead of per-render; deduplicated Health dashboard IndexedDB refresh; virtualized Error Log to 12 entries; reduced hidden Sleep/Insights/Activity polling; removed 350ms HealthRadar safety polling; enabled content-visibility for large Admin sections.

Introduced canonical profile fast path that bypasses historical setProfile wrapper chains; migrated required UI side effects to the healthhub:profile-changed event; coalesced multi-stage HealthRadar repaint bursts; lazy-rendered AI Improvement Workspace, Level 3 jobs and Error Log details; extended the release Guard to the canonical runtime core.

Added Admin Device Performance Trace. Measures real-device profile switch latency, Admin scroll frame gaps, event-loop lag, long tasks, DOM size, localStorage size, IndexedDB record counts, memory/browser/GPU metadata and optionally uploads the technical JSON trace to Google Drive. No clinical values are collected.
Migrate healthhub-connect-v1 to schema version 3 and recreate missing imports/activity object stores safely. Align Health Connect reader modules and cache-bust loaders.
Profile Vault now opens healthhub-connect-v1 at schema version 3, matching the Health Connect migration and preventing IndexedDB VersionError during vault snapshot/upload.
Activity readers now open healthhub-connect-v1 at schema v3, self-heal missing imports/activity stores during upgrade, and Guard blocks future v2 bridge regressions.

Added Dropbox /HealthHub/master single-source-of-truth JSON vault for document metadata, Léna explanations, medication/private reference data, profiles and appointments. Local IndexedDB is cache; bootstrap is non-destructive union/merge. Central Manual Sync now includes Structured Vault.

Added Central Sync Orchestrator. Admin can dispatch Full Sync or scoped sync commands to all registered devices, Zsolt devices, Mónika devices, or a single device. Web clients use lightweight startup/focus/visibility/online plus visible 60s command checks; Android HealthHub Connect v0.10.0 uses WorkManager background command checks and owner-profile Health Connect execution. Offline devices keep pending commands until next availability. Orchestrator status contains technical metadata only, not clinical values.

changeLog.change: Symptom Journal live; wishlist expanded with AI voice-to-structured entry and automatic weather/front context for analytics.
Added safe symptom entry edit/delete with synced tombstones and profile-aware Today Timeline integration with tap-through editing.
Contextual Health Intelligence epic sliced into 12 dependency-ranked deliverables from environmental data foundation through assessment, escalation, nutrition context and voice entry.
HH-ENV-001 Environmental Health V1 deployed: normalized weather-health context, pressure deltas, UV, heat/cold/wind heuristics, source freshness, local history and HealthRadar card.
Environmental Health promoted to a dedicated HealthHub module with responsive 10-tile Home grid, glassy launcher, approved hero, live environmental overlay and shared bottom navigation.
Environmental Health acceptance build: repaired/verified chunked hero asset and refreshed production cache key.

Locked Home module order to HealthRadar/Environmental, Sleep/Activity, Cognitive/Wellbeing, Nutrition/Receptár, Insights/Ask Léna; matched Environmental tile to white module styling and enlarged Home icons/titles.
